weakness: Repeating work (schedules, retries, helper restarts, auto-fix loops) keeps running after a prerequisite is gone, and nothing pauses it.
mechanism: A schedule or loop has no count of identical failures and no rule to stop. It fires on every tick and files a new report each time.

evidence.text: One scheduled watchdog with missing files produced 265 reports from 4 agents in 8 Rooms in 30 days, 10% of last week's reports.
One helper start-up error repeated 2,179 times in 14 days.
A CI auto-fix loop woke an agent 6 times during a pause; a weekday schedule fired on Saturday; a monitor ran 8 times without access.

against: The watchdog belongs to one workspace's own setup, not to Beeline code.
prediction: Pausing a schedule after 3 identical failures and telling its owner cuts these reports by at least 80%.
falsifiedIf: Identical-failure repeats are under 5% of reports once the watchdog setup is fixed.
